title: ADesk Cleaner
tagline: Registry-driven, preview-first Windows cleanup scripts. Pick one, read what it does, preview, then run.

groups.name: Autodesk & Revit
groups.blurb: Revit, AutoCAD, Navisworks, pyRevit, and Revit's caches

groups.name: Windows
groups.blurb: Bloat, legacy hardware residue, startup apps, the Search index

scripts.name: Uninstall Revit
scripts.summary: Autodesk Revit, any year: the core application plus its orphaned add-ins, content packs and exporters.

scripts.name: Uninstall AutoCAD
scripts.summary: Autodesk AutoCAD, any year: the whole per-year family (ODIS bundle, updates, the two hidden MSI children) plus orphaned add-ins.

scripts.name: Uninstall Navisworks
scripts.summary: Navisworks Manage / Simulate / Freedom, any year: the ODIS bundle, the hidden MSI child and all language packs. Preserves the NWC exporters by default.

scripts.name: Uninstall pyRevit
scripts.summary: pyRevit and pyRevit CLI: clones, add-in manifests, registrations, Start Menu and PATH entries. Never touches your own extensions or another drive.

scripts.name: Clear Revit caches
scripts.summary: Keeps Revit installed and clears its per-user caches: accelerator cache, web caches, journal history, and opt-in the collaboration cache and Recent models.

scripts.name: Uninstall Adobe products
scripts.summary: Creative Cloud products you select, by SAP code or name, through Adobe's own HyperDrive uninstaller. Preserves shared runtimes other Adobe apps still use.

scripts.name: Uninstall FortiClient
scripts.summary: Fortinet FortiClient: the MSI plus the network-stack residue it orphans - kernel drivers, driver-store packages, virtual adapter devnodes, firewall rules and config hives.

scripts.name: Remove Windows bloat
scripts.summary: Pre-installed Store apps, telemetry, tips and ads, Copilot / Recall, Bing in search, Widgets. Census-first; every registry value is backed up and restorable with -Restore.

scripts.name: Remove legacy hardware residue
scripts.summary: Every previous build's driver stack on a Windows install that moved between machines: driver packages, services, tasks, phantom devnodes and folders. Refuses any vendor whose hardware is still present.

scripts.name: Audit and clean startup apps
scripts.summary: Everything that launches itself at sign-in, across Run keys, Startup folders, packaged StartupTasks and logon tasks - with what each entry actually is. Disable, remove or restore.

scripts.name: Reset the Search index
scripts.summary: Resets and rebuilds the Windows Search index and lifts the self-throttling that otherwise makes the rebuild take days. Restores the ACL of the one owner-locked key it writes.

scripts.name: Clean a directory
scripts.summary: Recursive sweep for build junk (*.bak, __pycache__) under a directory you name.
